title: I coded crazy enchants
description: This mod adds 2 new crazy enchantments!
body:
I coded some cool and crazy enchantments: The first one is: Nethermite. This enchantment is to summon endermites based on the level when you damage a mob with it, enchantment appliable to a netherite sword. The second one is: Cat. This enchantment makes you ride a cat, and to get out of the cat, the only way is to take off the enchanted leather helmet, enchantment appliable to a leather helmet.

Made with [MCreator](https://www.mcreator.net)
